articles.title: Quantum computing nears commercial breakthrough, IBM CEO says
articles.snippet: Arvind Krishna said quantum computing will begin generating meaningful revenue before the decade ends as investment in the sector accelerates, in an interview on CNBC.

articles.title: New York sues Kalshi, alleges it offers a gambling platform 'plain and simple'
articles.snippet: The suit wants to bar the company from operating what it says is an unlicensed gambling business and seeks financial redress.

articles.title: Coinbase sinks 5% after missing second-quarter revenue estimates
articles.snippet: The company reported $1.22 billion in overall revenue, down from $1.5 billion in the year prior.

articles.title: Bybit adds tokenized Nvidia, Apple, Tesla stocks as loan collateral
articles.snippet: Eligible retail and institutional users can use tokenized shares of Nvidia, Apple, Tesla and three other US companies across Bybit’s trading and lending products.

articles.title: AMLBot launches AI Tracer for self-service blockchain investigations
articles.snippet: Crypto forensics company AMLBot launched an AI-enabled tool allowing users with no specialist knowledge to trace their digital assets, even after they are stolen.
